propositions: Provider qualification should be decided by membership in a known registry, not by shape matching a regex pattern, to correctly handle model IDs with colons and reject typos in configured providers at config-resolution time rather than at construction

The shape regex _PROVIDER_QUALIFIER_RE rejects valid provider names containing slashes (gateway/* names) and accepts arbitrary identifiers, both incorrect; membership in KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES (24 names from pydantic-ai) fixes both

Configured providers must be validated immediately in _resolve_target to report typos like 'bedrok' during config resolution; inline unrecognized prefixes should fall through as unqualified to preserve multi-colon model IDs like anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0

Test fixture values 'test' and 'google_genai' must be removed from the provider registry because neither is a real pydantic-ai provider; they produce incorrect recorded telemetry and mask unusable model configurations
